about: The three bugs the two baselines are measured on, each with the system's own cluster JUnit test (unchanged) as the workload.

rows.note: HDFS-17967 (apache/hadoop#8698) path A: a write pipeline head opens its own SASL connection to the next DataNode, which cannot resolve the block key. The test rotates block keys every 2 s and, without any fault, fails its client's stale key once at this check (then refreshes it); only a further failure is a candidate.

rows.note: A lost reply of the backup lock's checkAndMutate: the client retries the committed compare-and-set, finds its own lock and throws, so the backup fails and the lock stays. Its test has two sessions contend for the lock, so a fault-free run already takes the throw while one waits; only a further failure is a candidate.

ZooKeeper LeaderElectionSupport (election recipe): a contender whose start() fails reading an offer goes FAILED without revoking its own offer. The check is the server refusing a getData of a node that no longer exists (GraphChecker zk-bugs-election-offer marks the same throw).
